entities.summary: Filicudi is one of seven islands that make up the Aeolian archipelago, situated 46 km (29 mi) northeast of the island of Sicily, Southern Italy. It is a frazione of the comune of Lipari. Filicudi is a island in Southern Europe. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
